attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"It seems the pirates have a very efficient way of redistributing that surplus.","severity":"minor","reason":"links the robbed barge to the Combine's harvest; the briefing does not say the grain came from there (hedged with 'it seems', so borderline)"},{"span":"I suppose the pirates are tired of hunting for scraps and decided to take the whole meal instead.","severity":"minor","reason":"implied cause for the robbery, though framed as a guess"},{"span":"the Calder Combine had a good harvest","severity":"minor","reason":"repeats old news as a second item rather than a short clause, and the earlier bulletin said 'best in years'; mostly consistent"}],"voice":3,"clarity":4,"tone":4,"overall":3,"comment":"The lead is accurate and the dry jokes work, but the second paragraph pads with old news as a full item and implies the stolen grain came from the Combine harvest. A single-item bulletin of 40 to 80 words was needed, and this is padded with a recycled topic."}
